newsitem.title: USA: CME pork belly futures up sharply to limit.
newsitem.headline: CME pork belly futures up sharply to limit.

text.p: CME February pork belly futures ran up for a limit gain of 3.000 cents per lb and other months were sharply higher on demand ahead of USDA's Cold Storage Report, traders said.
February surged to a limit gain at 77.300 cents per lb while other months were up 2.300 to 2.400 cents with July up 2.300 at 91.350 cents.
Some analysts indicated the monthly Cold Storage Report could show an net out-movement for April versus the more typical net in-movement ahead of the primary summer usage season.
That possibility prompted commercial support and scattered shsort covering that triggered buy stops in the pork belly pit, sources said.
